lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical lines. Spacing is irregular, with significantly higher density in the posterior half of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 10th vertical line (counting from anterior) at the upper dorsal region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first three anterior lines terminate mid-flank before reaching the ventral torso line. The 12th posterior line is a truncated dorsal segment.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density cluster of approximately 8-10 white spots located on the lower haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four distinct spots align horizontally across the lower posterior flank, forming a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white chevron marking on the nasal bridge, white patch on the lower throat, and white transverse bands on the lower limbs.
